description: This Java class 'IdentityCache' implements a cache interface that always returns the key as the value, serving as an identity cache. It provides methods for retrieving, inserting, and invalidating cache entries but all modification methods are non-operational, emphasizing its read-only nature.

classes.name: IdentityCache
classes.description: A singleton class implementing a cache that always returns the key wrapped in an Entry as its value, essentially serving as an identity cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a completed future with the result of getBlocking, which always provides the key wrapped in an Entry.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Alias for get; in this implementation, it simply calls get.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing a permanent Entry of the key, effectively returning the key itself.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: No operation; always returns false indicating no cache invalidation.

methods.name: put
methods.description: No operation; does not store the value, reflecting a read-only cache behavior.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException indicating it cannot be viewed as a map.
